claim: Mechanism A collapse window, 200 consecutive ticks
observational_unit: TICK within ONE injected fault episode
independence_assumption: NONE VALID. Consecutive ticks of one episode are one event, not 200 replicates.
censoring: window ends when the fix returns
valid_interpretation: the collapse persisted for the whole injected window on this run
invalid_interpretation: 200 independent observations; any rate per tick; any CI

ci_method: none. A proportion CI here would imply sampling that did not happen.
valid_interpretation: two implementations agreed on every comparison performed
invalid_interpretation: a 100% accuracy rate; evidence the signature table is correct; a binomial CI

independence_assumption: trials plausibly independent; TICKS ARE NOT
ci_method: if any, a rule-of-three on TRIALS (0/20), not on ticks
censoring: trials end at their own duration
valid_interpretation: the predicate never collapsed in any fix-preserving trial
invalid_interpretation: 0/15595 as a per-tick failure rate; a tick-denominated CI

invalid_interpretation: a 100% success RATE generalising beyond this platform

claim: Mechanism A current stack, ArduPilot and PX4
valid_interpretation: the mechanism occurred, and the matched control did not show it
invalid_interpretation: any rate, frequency or prevalence; pooling the two platforms

independence_assumption: VIOLATED for the flight. Runs vary fault class, amplitude, onset and the clean/faulted split ONLY.
ci_method: Wilson, as reported -- but conditional on one trajectory
valid_interpretation: detection behaviour over faults on a fixed flight
invalid_interpretation: 150 independent flights; flight-to-flight variability; a fleet rate

claim: 26-log replay: 2 alert episodes in 0.5183 monitored hours
denominator: 0.5183 h MONITORED (post arm_time), not 0.663 h raw
independence_assumption: Poisson assumed for the interval; the corpus is 26 heterogeneous flights
ci_method: Poisson exact; CONDITIONAL on the process assumption
censoring: pre-arm window excluded by construction (no alert can fire there)
valid_interpretation: descriptive rate on this corpus, ~30-fold uncertainty
invalid_interpretation: a reliability figure; verified-healthy exposure (that is 0.000 h -- the corpus is UNANNOTATED)

claim: Mechanism B detector latencies (7.72 vs 2.96 etc.)
independence_assumption: none; four arms on one flight profile, one node (gps)
censoring: clean arm never crosses trust or CUSUM -- that is a NON-EVENT, not a censored latency
valid_interpretation: detector-to-detector comparison on these arms, dwell removed
invalid_interpretation: quoting 8.72 vs 2.96 (detector+policy vs detector); calling the CLEAN arm's lambda crossings latencies -- they are FALSE ALARMS
